SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q6. Which of the following is an example of ‘Coming Together Federation’?  
(A) India  
(B) Spain  
(C) USA  
(D) Belgium

Answer / Solution:
Which of the following is an example of ‘Coming Together Federation’? 
(C) USA 
Reasoning: The USA, Switzerland, and Australia are examples of ‘coming 
together’ federations. India and Spain are ‘holding together’ federations.
